scope: Cross-account global duplicate report and final pre-CONTINUA guard

tests.metadata_query_check: SELECT only, no PDF artifact or encrypted password columns

invariants: Global unique notice and source reservations remain active across all accounts
No CONTINUA after a detected conflict
No INVIA and no portal deletion
Cancelled outbox rows do not reserve a notice; positive portal evidence remains visible
Only latest stored draft snapshot per normalized username is compared
Unknown draft identifiers are counted without collapsing rows
limitations: No live all-account portal scan is performed by the report
Arbitrary manual shipment names are not matched
Archive shipments not yet imported are not certified
Legacy snapshots are partial until a complete refresh
Positive stale observations block conservatively pending a newer account snapshot
deployment_requirements: Backend and worker must both include new backend service
Keep campaign paused until explicit resumption
